title: FOC P09 lower-divider resistor OVP threshold recheck

scope.screen: FOC OVP comparator threshold endpoint non-regression only

model.input_location: NOM dictionary is hardcoded in the source; no separate model input file exists.

new_HoAR.endurance_condition: 70±2°C, 1000 h cyclic test; maximum resistance change ±0.5%

component_specs_used.part_identity_check: HoAR part is ±25 ppm/°C; no 10 ppm part was substituted.

method.lower_resistance_formula: 10000 Ω × (1 ± initial tolerance) × (1 + TCR × (T - 25°C)) × (1 ± endurance drift)
method.changed_parameters: Only R_OVBOT and R_OVREF_BOT resistance endpoints were extended. The source model's top-arm, SAFE_5V, comparator, hysteresis and pull-up corners were retained.

endurance_test_temperature_70C.note: Combines the resistor TCR at the endurance test temperature with the quoted endurance endpoint.

datasheet_rated_temperature_extremes.note: Sensitivity envelope combining the full rated TCR extremes and endurance endpoint; this is not a manufacturer guarantee that the extremes occur simultaneously or a lifetime qualification.

method.nonregression_boundary: PASS only if each new-part bus-on/off minimum is at least the matching old-part minimum and each new-part maximum is no greater than the matching old-part maximum.
method.absolute_design_limits: No independent OVP threshold acceptance window is encoded in this model; absolute design-limit compliance is not assessed.

part_swap_nonregression.overall: PASS for the defined relative component-corner non-regression boundary only. HoAR threshold ranges are contained within the old-part ranges in both sensitivity scenarios.

qualification_status.FOC_P09_full_OVP_threshold_error: OPEN; the corner screen does not model complete channel error or all real circuit effects.
qualification_status.FOC_hardware_or_bench_validation: OPEN; no hardware or bench test was performed.

separate_per_cell_E100.persisted_qualification_state: Not qualified / FAIL in the separate module record; unchanged by this FOC P09 screen.

qualification_status.prohibited_inference: Do not treat the OVP threshold ranges or part-swap PASS as an E100 pass, complete FOC qualification, or hardware acceptance.

reproducibility.scope_note: No source model, input, CAD, BOM, BMS, central index, or release file was changed by this calculation.
